text.p: This are the leading stories in Botswana's independent Guardian newspaper on Friday.
Reuters has not verified the stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Ketumile Masire has told members of a task group appointed to form a long term vision to guide development, that Botswana should work towards an annual economic growth rate of seven percent per annum over the next 25 years, a life expectancy of 80 years and at least 10 years of schooling for every citizen.
